documented_findings: cargo vendor vendors crates.io and git dependencies into the specified local path and the completed vendor directory contains remote sources for the specified dependencies.

The command prints the configuration necessary to use vendored sources to stdout after vendoring; the documentation says to add or redirect it to Cargo configuration, usually .cargo/config.toml locally for the current package.
Cargo treats vendored sources as read-only like registry and git sources.
cargo vendor ignores [source] configuration by default while downloading crates; --respect-source-config makes it read and use that source configuration.
